task: real AU title/full-description field/span extraction ONLY; no condition classifier or SKU acceptance
selection_rule: one lexicographically first v7 unresolved row per 12 explicitly stratified AU products; no accessory prefilter, no label selection
strata: curtain model_candidate and reverse count residual
label_kind: Luna machine annotations; development data previously used by multiple sessions
train_test: no training/split/held-out accuracy claimed; sibling Rakuten URLs and repeated AU descriptions must stay grouped in future splits

fields.dimension: Exact size, width, height, length, diameter or dimensions of a product, including units.
fields.piece_count: Exact numbers of included pieces, panels, doors, sets, or components with their names.
fields.material: Material or fabric of a product.
fields.color: Color name or pattern of a product.
fields.product_type: Product type, model variant or construction style.
fields.included_item: Items stated to be included or excluded, including conditional inclusion.

baseline: literal unresolved selected value matches in same full text; citations are candidates only, never support
metrics: output shape, exact source offsets, partial machine-quote overlap/retention; no independent precision/recall or semantic three-state accuracy
reverse_residual_policy: AU-side residuals remain untested; require Rakuten evidence
chunk_policy: token-budgeted complete scan with overlap; record every chunk and validate coverage
